title: Fox eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fox body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#ff8c2e'/>
  <!-- chest lighter shade -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#ffd9a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#ff8c2e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='34,28 30,10 44,24' fill='#ff8c2e'/>
  <polygon points='66,28 70,10 56,24' fill='#ff8c2e'/>
  <!-- ear tips -->
  <polygon points='33,24 31,14 40,23' fill='#7a3d10'/>
  <polygon points='67,24 69,14 60,23' fill='#7a3d10'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <polygon points='35,26 33,17 41,24' fill='#ffb3b3'/>
  <polygon points='65,26 67,17 59,24' fill='#ffb3b3'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#ffd9a8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='38' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='38' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#fff7d6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#fff7d6'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a1a1a'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='45' r='4' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='45' r='4' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- snack held in paws -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='7' fill='#c96b1e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='5' fill='#e88a3a'/>
  <!-- bite mark -->
  <path d='M54,54 A6,6 0 0,1 57,60 A4,4 0 0,0 54,54 Z' fill='#ffd9a8'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='62' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffb066' transform='rotate(-20 40 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='62' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffb066' transform='rotate(20 60 62)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72,74 Q88,70 86,56 Q84,46 76,50 Q82,58 74,64 Z' fill='#ff8c2e'/>
  <path d='M86,56 Q84,46 76,50 Q80,54 84,62 Z' fill='#ffd9a8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ff8c2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ff8c2e'/>
</svg>
